scenes.text: OpenAI's new model *does the clicking*: invoices into the books, at *half the price*

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 26: GPT-6.1 Terra, built for computer use. OpenAI's own example: read incoming invoices and enter them into accounting software.
It also fills forms, drafts proposals and reads technical drawings.

scenes.title: What it *means* for you
lines: Data entry is the first freelance job this eats. If you sell bookkeeping, sell the review and the advice, not the typing.
It runs in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu. Not in regular ChatGPT chat yet.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: OpenAI says three times faster than GPT-6 Astra on agent tasks. Vendor numbers, no outside test yet.
Source: OpenAI, Oct 26; AI Catchup, Oct 27, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: API: $1 per million input tokens, $5 output. Half of GPT-6.1 Sol.
One invoice run costs cents. That is why the price of data entry is heading to zero.

scenes.text: Is *data entry* dead? *Yes or no* below.
